The manager reads from config.yaml (mounted via ConfigMap) with environment variable overrides:
The manager runs as ServiceAccount daytona-runnermanager in the tools namespace.

The manager starts in read-only mode . Every write operation is gated behind a feature flag that can be toggled at runtime via POST /features without a restart. Feature state persists across pod restarts via a K8s ConfigMap.

Why the pod restart? The runner daemonset reads its API key from CONFIG_FILE_PATH=/host-token/token.txt only at startup. Since the daemonset pod starts before we can write the token, we write it and then restart the pod so it picks it up.
